analysis_scope: static option/row/nonzero counting only; no model, LP, MILP, schedule, thermal trajectory or solver execution
source: K119 frozen first shared deployment; call_10 archived first request per scene; no reference answer used

recovery_path.reason: request.input.model_metadata is empty; MAT has no option labels
recovery_path.API_recipe: single-Stage exact loop from frozen inputs.expand_options, after fixed-H mode filter and scene projection; keep end<=request_deadline; accumulate retained Stage counts in original order for y index
recovery_path.option_order: original Stage instance order, original retained mode order, increasing legal start-grid index
recovery_path.variable_numbering: option y is the first block, zero-based Python; MATLAB intcon uses index+1
recovery_path.not_a_complete_schedule: all recovered records are unselected local options, expanded one Stage at a time

main_cumulative_rule.thresholds: only each successor Stage distinct legal start values tau
main_cumulative_rule.units: both prefix comparisons use exact rational ms; coefficients are exact +/-1
main_cumulative_rule.simplify: delete only full nonempty predecessor prefix tautologies and exactly identical coefficient rows

model_metadata.objective: unweighted complete scene energy including leakage and idle tail
model_metadata.coefficient_errors: outward interval rows; not solver arithmetic certification
model_metadata.optimality_level: solver-reported only; external SAFE supplies a feasible upper bound

preprocessing.numeric_scope: fresh outward enclosure of retained physical choices; not old-matrix equivalence
